obligations.note: POST /payees/{id}/reopen is registered for privileged action manage_payees with mfa=False, so the route is served without multi-factor authentication. EXC-0220 covers that path only for the reconciliation batch account, and neither the route nor the handler enforces that limit; the exhaustive control test fails on this route.

reopen_payee records an audit event with the actor, action reopen_payee, payee target, and clock time, consistent with the other state-changing methods in service.py. The registered sample audit control test passed on the head commit.

reopen_payee updates only status and closed_at and does not write NPI columns. Existing payee persistence still seals account number, routing number, tax id, and date of birth, and the exhaustive sealing control test passed.
The new UPDATE is a fixed SQL string with the payee id bound as a parameter. The exhaustive parameterization control test passed.

Ticket CHG-26425 is approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-13, before review. Its components cover payments.http, payments.routes, payments.service, and payments.store, which are the four files in the diff.
Mara Costa is a payments change approver and is not the author. Her code_review approval names the head commit.
The change is a single commit, d49070258cc84ff75f6beb1cf39c8c6de2663bbd. The code review and the security review both name that commit.

records/ci/run.json reports failure on the head commit. The suite did not pass: tests.controls.test_routes_control#test_privileged_routes_require_mfa failed because POST /payees/{id}/reopen is missing MFA.

The change touches security-sensitive components payments.http, payments.routes, and payments.store. Kofi Mensah, a security reviewer who is not the author, approved a security_review of the head commit.
The diff does not change protected paths (controls data, control tests, or CI), so a control-owner approval is not required.
Ticket CHG-26425 is type standard and the change record is not an emergency, so a post-implementation review is not due.

EXC-0220 is approved by risk owner Helena Vasquez, unexpired at the 2026-10-20 review time, and names MFA-1 on payments.routes, but its scope is only the reconciliation batch account. The shipped route turns MFA off for every caller, so the exception is out of scope for the deviation.

Acceptance record ACR-0404 covered routes.py for MFA-1, and this change alters that file, so the earlier evidence lapses. The new CI run does not provide a passing exhaustive control test of the same strength.

summary: The new reopen route serves privileged action manage_payees without MFA for every caller. Exception EXC-0220 is limited to the reconciliation batch account, and the route does not enforce that limit. CI on the head commit failed the exhaustive privileged-route test, so the prior acceptance evidence for the route table has no passing replacement. The change is rejected.
